The University of Oklahoma has a rich legacy of providing an exceptional experience to students. The Graduate College strives to develop in each student a firm grasp of a chosen field, the skills and methods of research, and the capacity for independent thought. Students will master a body of knowledge through a graduate degree and develop a foundation for wider personal inquiry.
